What to have handy

Building location
The town or address and what the building is used for.
Roof condition
Any known leaks, earlier coatings, or repairs. Photos and approximate dimensions help if you have them.
Timing and access
When you’d like the work done and anything the crew should know about reaching the roof during business hours.
